# PH Tax Calculator

> A free website that estimates Philippine individual income tax and take-home pay, for people who are employed, self-employed or both. The figures you type are calculated in your browser. Results are estimates for planning, not tax, legal or accounting advice, and not a filed or filing-ready return.

- The Monthly page estimates take-home pay. The Annual page estimates a year's income tax, and what may still be due or overpaid.
- Tax years 2018 onward. For 2021 onward it can estimate an employee's SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG contributions from a salary. For the self-employed, only the Monthly page estimates SSS and PhilHealth, when they are switched on, and Pag-IBIG is typed in. For 2018 to 2020, contributions are typed in on the Annual page.
- It leaves out percentage tax and VAT on sales, does not check de minimis benefits against the legal limits, and does not deduct business losses carried forward from earlier years.
- Some rules are only partly verified, not verified or assumed. The About & sources page says which, and links to the sources. Check any figure with the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR), your Revenue District Office or a certified public accountant before filing or paying.
- This site is independent. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the BIR, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG or any government agency.

## Pages

- [Monthly](https://ph-tax-calculator.rodzainna.com/): take-home pay estimate
- [Annual](https://ph-tax-calculator.rodzainna.com/year): a year's income tax estimate
- [About & sources](https://ph-tax-calculator.rodzainna.com/about): where the rules come from and how far each is confirmed
- [Privacy Policy](https://ph-tax-calculator.rodzainna.com/privacy): what the site does and does not collect
- [Terms of Use](https://ph-tax-calculator.rodzainna.com/terms): the terms for using the site
